scenes.title: Median 2-bed asking price
scenes.note: Source: APG analysis of live listings, Oct 2026. Medians, 2-bed homes. Asking prices. £1 = J$213.
scenes.vo: A typical two-bed in Clarendon is listed at around seventy thousand pounds. St Elizabeth and St Catherine come in next. At the top, St Mary, at over three hundred thousand.
That's roughly ninety-two thousand to four hundred and four thousand US dollars.
